senses.gloss:
स्तक् स्तक्, cl. 1. P. स्तकति, तस्ताक, स्त-
कितुम्, to resist; to strike against, repel:
Caus. स्तकयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अतिष्टकत्.

स्तन् स्तन्, cl. 1. P. स्तनति, तस्तान, स्त-
नितुम्, to sound, make a sound, resound,
reverberate; to groan, breathe hard, sigh; cl. 10. P.
स्तनयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अतस्तनत्, to thunder:
Caus. स्तनयति (or स्तानयति according to some),
-यितुम्, Aor. अतिष्टनत् (or अतिस्तनत् according
to some), to cause to resound: Desid. तिस्तनिषति:
Intens, तंस्तन्यते, तंस्तन्ति; [cf. Gr. στέν-ω,
στενάχ-ω, στόνο-ς, στένο-μαι, στείνομαι, στενό-ς,
στεινό-ς, στεῖνος, Στέν-τωρ: Lat. tono, tonitru:
Old Norse stynija, styn: Old Germ. stunôd, ‘a
sigh;’ thonar, donar, ‘thunder:’ Old Sax. thunar:
Angl. Sax. thunor: Lith. sten-e-ti: Slav. sten-a-ti,
‘to groan.’]

स्तन, अस्, m. the breast of a woman, (probably
[]
so called from the noise made in breathing); the
nipple of the breast; an udder or dug or breast of
any female animal, (at the end of an adj. comp. the
fem. may end in आ or ई, according to Vopa-deva IV.
17, but the more usual form is in ई.)
—स्तन-
कलश, अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘goblet-like breast,’ a
woman's breast.
—स्तन-कुट्मल, अम्, n. ‘breast-
bud,’ a woman's breast.
—स्तन-तट, अस्, m. the
slope of the breasts, (see तट.)
—स्तनन्-धम,
अस्, आ, m. f. = स्तनन्-धय below.
—स्तनन्-
धय, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, breast-sucking, sucking at
the breast; (अस्, आ), m. f. an infant; a suckling.
—स्तन-प, अस्, आ, अम्, or स्तन-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्,
or स्तन-पायक, अस्, इका, अम्, or स्तन-पायिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, breast-sucking, sucking the breast or udder;
an infant at the breast, suckling.
—स्तन-पान, अम्,
n. the drinking or sucking of the breast.
—स्तन-
भर, अस्, m. ‘breast-possessing,’ a man with a
breast like a woman's.
—स्तन-भव, अस्, आ, अम्,
being on the breast; (अस्), m. a particular posture
in sexual union.
—स्तन-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘breast-
orb,’ a woman's breast.
—स्तन-मध्य or स्तन-
मुख, अस्, m. ‘breast-point,’ a nipple.
—स्तन-
वृन्त, अस्, m. ‘breast-stalk,’ a nipple.
—स्तन-
शिखा, f. ‘breast-point,’ a nipple.
—स्तनांशुक
(˚न-अं˚), अम्, n. ‘breast-mantle,’ a cloth covering
the bosom.
—स्तनाग्र (˚न-अग्˚), अस्, m. ‘breast-
point,’ a nipple.
—स्तनाङ्ग-राग (˚न-अङ्˚), अस्, m.
paint or pigment on the breasts (of women).
—स्त-
नान्तर (˚न-अन्˚), अम्, n. ‘breast-interval,’ the
heart (as situated under the centre bone of the
sternum); a mark on the breast (supposed to indi-
cate future widowhood).
—स्तना-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. feeding or nourishing with the udder (said of
cows).
—स्तनाभोग (˚न-आभ्˚), अस्, m. fulness or
swelling of the breast, the expanding of the bosom
of a young woman; the circumference or orb of the
breast; a man with large breasts like those of a
woman.
स्तनथ, अस्, m., Ved. thunder.

स्तनन, अम्, n. sounding, sound, noise; the
rumbling of clouds; groaning; breathing hard.

स्तनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, thundering.
—स्तनयद्-
अमास्, m. pl. (see अमा, p. 74, col. 3), Ved. roaring
together, sounding in concert (said of the Maruts).

स्तनयित्नु, उस्, m. thundering, thunder, the mut-
tering of clouds; a cloud; lightning; sickness;
death; a kind of grass (= मुस्तक).
—स्तनयित्नु-
घोष, अस्, आ, अम्, loud as thunder.

स्तनित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, sounding; thun-
dering; (अम्), n. the rattling of thunder, rumbling
of thunder-clouds; thunder, noise; the noise of
clapping the hands.
—स्तनित-फल, अस्, m. the
plant Vikaṇṭaka.

स्तन्य, अम्, n. (fr. स्तन), ‘that which is to be
drawn from the breast,’ mother's milk, milk.
—स्त-
न्य-त्याग, अस्, m. leaving off the mother's milk,
weaning.
—स्तन्य-त्याग-मात्रक, अस्, आ, अम्,
only just weaned.
—स्तन्य-पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or
स्तन्य-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, sucking or feeding on milk,
sucking at the breast.
स्तब्ध स्तब्ध, &c. See col. 2.

स्तब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed, firm, stiff, rigid, hard,
immovable, motionless, numb, paralyzed, senseless,
stupid, dull, insensible, indifferent; stopped, brought
to a stand, blocked up; obstinate, stubborn, hard-
hearted; coarse; [cf. Old Germ. stīf; Mod. Germ.
steif; Engl. stiff.]
—स्तब्ध-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्,
‘stiff-eared,’ having the ears fixed, pricking up the
ears.
—स्तब्ध-ता, f. or स्तब्ध-त्व, अम्, n.
fixedness, rigidity, immobility, steadiness, stupor,
stubbornness.
—स्तब्ध-रोमन्, आ, m. ‘stiff-
bristled,’ a boar, hog.
—स्तब्ध-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्,
having fixed or unwinking eyes (applied as an epi-
thet to the gods who are supposed to be known by
this characteristic).
—स्तब्धी-करण, अम्, n. the
act of making stiff, stiffening, making rigid, para-
lyzing.
—स्तब्धी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made stiff,
stiffened, rigid, paralyzed.
—स्तब्धी-कृत्य, ind.
having stiffened or made rigid.
—स्तब्धी-भाव,
अस्, m. the becoming stiffened or rigid, torpidity.

स्तभ स्तभ, अस्, m. a goat; a ram; [cf.
स्तुभ.]

स्तम् स्तम् (= rt. 1. सम्), cl. 1. P. स्तमति,
तस्ताम, स्तमितु, to be confused or
agitated; (according to some) not to be confused,
see rt. 1. सम्; cl. 10. P. स्तमयति, to be agitated,
&c.

स्तम्ब स्तम्ब, अस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. IV. 96.
said to be fr. rt. 1. स्था; probably connected with
स्तम्भ, q. v.), a clump of grass, &c.; a sheaf of
corn; any clump or bunch or cluster; a bush,
thicket; a shrub or plant having no decided stem
(such as the Jhiṇṭī or Barleria); the post to which
an elephant is tied; any post or pillar, (in this and
the next sense probably for स्तम्भ, but said by
some to be neut.); stupefaction, insensibility; a
mountain; [cf. Angl. Sax. stapel.]
—स्तम्ब-करि,
[]
इस्, m. ‘forming clusters,’ corn, rice.
—स्तम्ब-कार,
अस्, ई, अम्, making a clump, forming a cluster.
—स्तम्ब-घन, अस्, m. ‘clump-destroyer,’ a small
hoe for weeding or eradicating clumps of grass, &c.;
a sickle for cutting corn; a basket for holding the
heads of wild rice, &c.
—स्तम्ब-घात = स्तम्ब-
घ्न below.
—स्तम्ब-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, clump-
destroying, weed-destroying; (अस्), m. a hoe or
sickle.
—स्तम्ब-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, growing on a
clump or bush; growing on a post.
—स्तम्ब-पुर्,
ऊर्, f., N. of the city Tāmalipta, q. v.
—स्तम्ब-
मित्र, अस्, m., N. of the author of Ṛg-veda X.
142, 7, 8 (having the patronymic Śārṅga).
—स्तम्-
ब-हन् or स्तम्ब-हनन, अम्, ई, n. f. ‘clump-
destroyer,’ a hoe for eradicating weeds; a sickle for
cutting corn.
—स्तम्बे-रम, अस्, m. ‘delighting
in clumps of high grass,’ an elephant.

स्तम्भ् स्तम्भ् or स्तभ् (connected with
rt. स्कम्भ्, q. v.; in native lists written
स्तन्भ्), cl. 5. 9. P. स्तभ्नोति, स्तभ्नाति, (2nd
sing. Impv. स्तभान), तस्तम्भ, अस्तम्भीत् or
अस्तभत्, स्तम्भितुम् (originally perhaps ‘to
stamp’), to fix firmly, make firm, make stiff or im-
movable; to paralyze, stupefy; to prop, support, prop
up, sustain; to create (Ved.); to stop, arrest, suppress,
oppose, hinder; cl. 1. A. स्तम्भते, तस्तम्भे (ac-
cording to some also टष्टम्भे, ष्टम्भते), &c.,
to become fixed or immovable, to become senseless
or insensible, become stiff or rigid: Pass. स्तभ्यते,
Aor. अस्तम्भि: Caus. स्तम्भयति, -यितुम्, Aor.
अतस्तम्भत्, to fix, make firm or immovable, to
make stiff or rigid, stupefy, paralyze, stun; to prop,
support; stop, arrest, bring to a stand, suppress, re-
strain: Desid. तिस्तम्भिषति: Intens. तास्तभ्यते;
[cf. Gr. στέμφ-υλο-ν, ἀ-στεμφ-ής, στέμβ-ω,
στεμβ-άζω, στοβέ-ω, στοβάζ-ω, στείβ-ω; Lat. stupeo,
stipes; Old Germ. stamph, stamphon, stab;
Mod. Germ. stampfen; Old Norse stofn.]

स्तब्धि, इस्, f. fixedness, hardness, rigidity, firm-
ness, immobility, stupor, numbness, obstinacy.
स्तब्ध्वा, ind. = स्तम्भित्वा.
स्तभित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = स्तब्ध.
स्तभु, n. = स्तम्भन.

स्तभूय (fr. स्तभु), Nom. A. स्तभूयते,
&c., Ved. to desire to support.

स्तभूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring to
support, upholding.
स्तभ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being made firm.

स्तम्भ, अस्, m. fixedness, stiffness, rigidity;
immobility, a prop, support, fulcrum; a pillar,
column, post; a stem, stock, trunk; insensibility,
stupor, stupefaction (from fear, joy, grief, &c.);
numbness, paralysis, torpor; stupidity, coldness, want
of feeling or excitability; stoppage, obstruction, hin-
drance; suppression; a particular faculty acquired by
magical means, the supernatural suppression or ar-
resting of any feeling or force (as of hunger, thirst,
or the forces of fire, water, &c.; this is one of the
षट्-कर्मन् described as taught in the Tantras,
see p. 1032, col. 3; many varieties of Stambha are
enumerated, e. g. जल-स्त्˚, वह्नि-स्त्˚, वायु-स्त्˚,
[]
क्षुत्-स्त्˚, पिपासा-स्त्˚, निद्रा-स्त्˚, and in the case of
the first of these one effect of this faculty is to enable
a person to walk on the waters); N. of a Ṛṣi;
[cf. Angl. Sax. steb.]
—स्तम्भ-कर, अस्, ई, अम्,
causing obstruction; causing stiffness, paralyzing;
(अस्), m. a fence, railing, &c.
—स्तम्भ-कारण,
अम्, n. cause of obstruction or impediment.
—स्तम्-
भ-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place.
—स्तम्भ-पूजा,
f. worship of the posts of the temporary pavilions
erected for marriages or other festive occasions.
—स्तम्भी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to become
a post.
—स्तम्भोत्कीर्ण (˚भ-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
carved out of a post of wood (as a statue).

स्तम्भक, अस्, इका, अम्, fixing, propping, stop-
ping, restraining.

स्तम्भकिन्, ई, m. a kind of musical instrument
covered with leather.

स्तम्भन, अम्, n. the act of fixing firmly,
making stiff or hard or rigid, making like a post,
(रम्भा-स्तम्भन, the turning of the nymph
Rambhā into a pillar by the curse of Viśvā-mitra, see
Rāmāyaṇa I. 64); paralyzing, stupefying, stunning,
benumbing; propping or supporting, holding up-
right; stopping, making immovable, hindering,
arresting, bringing to a stand, suppression, obstruc-
tion; stopping of hemorrhage, staunching the flow
of blood; anything employed as a styptic or astrin-
gent; a particular magical act or faculty, suppression
of any of the bodily feelings or forces of nature by
supernatural means, (see under स्तम्भ; जल-
स्तम्भन = जल-स्तम्भ); (अस्, ई, अम्), fixing
immovably, paralyzing, supporting, stopping; (अस्),
m. ‘the paralyzer,’ epithet of one of the five arrows
of Kāma-deva, (the names of the other four are
Unmādana, Śoṣaṇa, Tāpana, and Sammohana.)

स्तम्भनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fixed firmly; to
be propped; to be stopped.

स्तम्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed firmly; stiffened,
benumbed, paralyzed, stupefied, senseless; propped
up, supported; stopped, brought to a standstill, sup-
pressed; staunched; restrained, constrained.
—स्तम्-
भित-रम्भ, अम्, n., N. of a particular Troṭaka
or drama; [cf. रम्भा-स्तम्भन above.]
—स्तम्-
भित-वाष्प-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, suppressing the flow
of tears.
—स्तम्भिताश्रु (˚त-अश्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, one
who has suppressed his tears.

स्तम्भित्वा, ind. having fixed, having stopped,
having suppressed.

स्तम्भिन्, ई, इनी, इ, supporting; stopping, re-
straining; (इनी), f. one of the five Dhāraṇās or
elements (= earth, see भ्रमणी).

स्तर स्तर, स्तरण, स्तरिमन्, &c. See
p. 1144, col. 1.

स्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, spreading, extending, covering,
&c.; (अस्), m. anything spread, a layer, stratum; a
bed, couch.
स्तव स्तव, स्तवक, &c. See p. 1143.

स्तव, अस्, m. praising, celebrating, hymning;
praise, eulogium, panegyric.
—स्तव-राज, अस्, m.,
N. of a particular mystical prayer or incantation.
—स्तवावलि, इस्, or स्तवावली (˚व-आव्˚), f., N. of
a work by Kavi-candra.
स्ताव स्ताव. See p. 1143, col. 1.

स्ताव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praising, one who praises,
a praiser; (अस्), m. praise.

स्तवरक स्तवरक, अस्, m. (doubtful), a
fence, railing (= आवरक).

स्तामु स्तामु, उस्, m. (= स्तोतृ, Naigh. III.
16), Ved. a praiser, worshipper.

स्तवक, अस्, इका, अम्, praising, eulogising; (अस्),
m. a panegyrist, praiser; praise, eulogium; a cluster
of blossoms, bunch of flowers, nosegay, tuft, (in
these senses said to be fr. rt. 1. स्था according to
Uṇādi-s. IV. 96); N. of the chapters in the Kusu-
māñjali; a quantity, multitude; [cf. स्तोम.]
—स्त-
वकाचित (˚क-आच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, covered with blos-
soms, in blossom.

स्तावक, अस्, m. a praiser, panegyrist, eulogiser,
flatterer.
स्तवकित, अस्, आ, अम्, full of blossoms.
स्तवथ, अस्, m., Ved. praise, (Sāy. = स्तोत्र.)
स्तवन, अम्, n. praising, praise; a hymn.

स्तवान, अस्, आ, अम्, being praised, being lauded
or glorified, (Sāy. = स्तूयमान.)

स्तवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praiseworthy,
laudable.
स्तवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, lauding, praising.

स्तवान्, nom. c. masc., Ved. being praised or
lauded, (Sāy. = स्तूयमान, Ṛg-veda VI. 24, 8.)
स्तवितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, &c.
स्तवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a praiser, praising.
स्तवेय्य (according to some) = स्तुवेय्य.
स्ताविन्, ई, इनी, इ, praising, hymning.

स्ताव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be praised, praise-
worthy.

स्तरण, अम्, n. the act of spreading, strewing,
scattering.

स्तरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spread; to be
strewn or scattered.
स्तरिमन्, आ, m. ‘that which is spread,’ a bed, couch.
स्तरीमन्, आ, m. = स्तरिमन् above.

स्तरी, ईस्, f. smoke, vapour; a heifer; a barren cow
(acc. c. स्तर्यम्, Ṛg-veda I. 118, 20; in this sense
probably connected with स्थिर, q. v.); [cf. Gr. στεῖρα
(for στερια); Lat. sterilis; Goth. stairo.]

स्तायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. stealing, acting stealthily,
(Atharva-veda IV. 16, 1.)
